title: C1 Milestone 2: Review Test
completion_message: ¡Formidable! Has superado el Milestone 2 del Nivel C1. Eres capaz de usar gramática altamente sofisticada (Participle Clauses, Future Perfect) y dominas el vocabulario técnico de innovación y leyes. ¡Un ejecutivo completo!

parts.visual:
En este hito repasaremos las lecciones 6 a 9 del nivel C1: 
- Advanced Future Forms (By Friday, I will have finished / At 10 AM, I will be presenting). 
- Participle Clauses (Having finished the report... / Exhausted, I went to bed...).
parts.audio: In this test we will review lessons 6 to 9 of the C1 level. We will test your knowledge of Advanced Future Forms, like 'By Friday, I will have finished' or 'At 10 AM, I will be presenting'. We will also review Participle Clauses, such as 'Having finished the report' or 'Exhausted, I went to bed'.

parts.visual:
También evaluaremos tu uso de vocabulario avanzado de Innovación y Contratos: 
- Innovation & Tech (Disruptive, scalable, paradigm shift, obsolete, pain point). 
- Contracts & Legal (Binding, loophole, breach of contract, liability, draft). 
¡Demuestra tu dominio técnico y legal del inglés de negocios!
parts.audio: We will also test your use of advanced Innovation and Contracts vocabulary. Innovation terms like disruptive, scalable, paradigm shift, and obsolete. And Legal terms such as binding, loophole, breach of contract, liability, and draft. Show your technical and legal mastery of business English!

stages.title: Milestone Quiz
stages.description: Elige la respuesta correcta en este desafío C1.

questions.question: By December, we ____ the new software. (Habremos implementado - Future Perfect).
questions.explanation: By December indica que la acción estará completada.

questions.question: ____ the contract, she immediately called her lawyer. (Habiendo leído).
questions.explanation: Participle Clause de secuencia (primero leyó, luego llamó).

questions.question: The smart phone was a ____ technology that changed the world. (Disruptiva).
The lawyers found a ____ in the tax code. (Vacío legal).
At 2 PM tomorrow, I ____ to the board of directors. (Estaré presentando - Future Continuous).
questions.explanation: Acción en progreso en un momento específico futuro.

questions.question: ____ by a famous architect, the building is stunning. (Diseñado).
questions.explanation: Participle Clause Pasiva (Designed = Because it was designed).

questions.question: A digital business is highly ____ because it can grow without huge extra costs. (Escalable).
If you fail to pay on time, it will be considered a ____ of contract. (Incumplimiento).
By the time he arrives, the meeting ____. (Habrá terminado - Future Perfect).
Not ____ what to do, I asked my manager. (No sabiendo).
This equipment is completely ____. We need to buy new machines. (Obsoleto).
Both parties signed, so the agreement is now legally ____. (Vinculante / Obligatorio).
I can't meet you at 10 AM. I ____ a client then. (Estaré viendo).
____ in 1990, the company has survived many crises. (Fundada).
The invention of the internet caused a ____ shift in communication. (Cambio de paradigma).
The company accepts no ____ for injuries caused by the user. (Responsabilidad legal).
By 2050, we ____ a base on Mars. (Habremos establecido).
____ out of money, they had to declare bankruptcy. (Habiéndose quedado).
questions.explanation: Having run out of money (Razón en pasado).

questions.question: Our software solves a major ____ point for accounting firms. (Punto de dolor).
If you break the rules, we will ____ you for $1 million. (Demandar).

Legally ____. (Vinculante con B)
